decisions.rationale: The 2025 NOA shows $104,077 total income and the monthly pay stub annualizes to about $105,000, supporting the stated $103,500.
A $21,250 cash deposit on 2026/05/11 is large and unexplained, and the balance excluding it is only about $116,900 against a $102,000 down payment plus closing costs.
The appraisal by Prairie Oak (on panel, $681,000 value) recommends a foundation engineer inspection that has not been cleared.
GDS is about 33.1% and TDS about 36.2% once the paid-in-full closed vehicle loan is excluded, with a 708 credit score.
